cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(fbtcal CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
add_library(driver_fbtcal SHARED src/driver.cpp)
target_include_directories(driver_fbtcal PRIVATE include)
target_link_libraries(driver_fbtcal PRIVATE rt)
set_target_properties(driver_fbtcal PROPERTIES PREFIX ""
  LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/fbtcal/bin/linux64)
